Name: Back from a match
Notes: ROUND AN (Anthony: the Dorms are where EVERY player rests). WHAT SENDS A PLAYER TO THE DORMS, one row per activity. Turns blank = how long comes from data/Recovery.csv by the player's power (a number here sets it outright). Extra is added on top. Wakes Others = true means this activity counts as a fixture, so everybody already in the Dorms is one fixture nearer to fit. The whole thing only runs while `recovery` in Tuning.csv is true

Name: Back from an Adventure
Notes: The party that went out on an Adventure, whether they walked home, fled or fell (fleeing counts as a round, Anthony, 8 Oct, Q208). An Adventure is a fixture like a match, so the players who stayed home get one fixture of rest back

Name: Carried home from an Adventure
Notes: ON TOP OF the adventure row, for a player who was knocked out (stamina 0) during the run. Extra 1 = one more fixture in bed than the others. 0 = being knocked out costs nothing extra

Name: Sleeping off a brew
Notes: SWITCHED OFF (Anthony, 8 Oct: Brew Players are the BREWERS, not the Pub's drinkers - see the brewer row). Turn On back to true and a player who played on a one-match Pub brew sleeps one fixture longer. ON TOP OF the match row, for a player who played a match on a one-match brew from the Pub. Extra 1 = one more fixture in bed. Set On to false and a brew costs no extra rest

Name: Resting after a shift at the Brewery
Notes: ROUND AN (Anthony: Brew Players are trained at the Training Ground to be brewers only). A brewer who has just worked a Brewery machine rests here for Turns fixtures (1 = one fixture) before he can work again. Blank Turns = by his efficiency, the same as a player's power in Recovery.csv
